intro.text: A name given to the day of the contest of champions.

items.text: Cultivation helped bind the three Shards to Roshar and limit their war through mortal agents.
Odium promised to accept a contest of champions in exchange for Honor removing Ba-Ado-Mishram.
Dalinar briefly took up Honor, then renounced his oaths rather than continue the war between the powers.
Taravangian combined Honor and Odium as Retribution and folded the highstorm into the Everstorm.
The renewed Oathpact protected the spren from Retribution; Azir and the Shattered Plains remained independent.
